scope: YouTube videos and creator income affected by audio sourcing, synchronization rights, Content ID and claim disputes.

options.name: YouTube Audio Library
options.geography: YouTube Studio access subject to account and country rules
options.video_scope: Video use under applicable library track terms
options.youtube_creator_income_effect: No Content ID claim expected for permitted Audio Library usage
options.attribution: Some Creative Commons tracks require credit; check the track

options.name: Creator Music no-cost tracks
options.geography: Documented availability for US YouTube Partner Program creators; other countries not presumed supported
options.video_scope: Eligible long-form videos subject to each track and license restrictions
options.youtube_creator_income_effect: Ordinary applicable creator revenue share if all track conditions met

options.name: Creator Music rights-holder revenue sharing
options.geography: Documented availability for US YouTube Partner Program creators; other countries not presumed supported
options.video_scope: Eligible long-form videos, not Shorts or live streams
options.youtube_creator_income_effect: The standard watch-page creator share can be reduced to accommodate track owners and other music-rights costs; track count and conditions matter

options.name: Creator Music previously paid licenses
options.geography: Product rules for eligible US creators before phase-out; do not project availability elsewhere
options.video_scope: Existing applied licenses continue until their terms expire
options.youtube_creator_income_effect: Previously licensed usage subject to its original contract; not a new paid-license route
options.unused_license_refunds: YouTube states unused previously purchased licenses are automatically refunded

options.name: Third-party or self-negotiated music rights
options.geography: Depends on the actual agreement and territorial permissions
options.video_scope: Rights must cover the specific use, period, platform and countries
options.youtube_creator_income_effect: External permission does not automatically suppress Content ID claims

claim_outcomes.meaning: Matched use can be blocked, potentially in specific territories
Rights holder may monetize identified content, sometimes sharing ad revenue with uploader
Rights holder may track video usage without that result itself specifying an earnings loss
Disputed monetized claims may have revenue held and later allocated based on the outcome

accounting_fields.required_evidence: Invoice or documented track-specific no-cost terms
Contemporaneous logs of track search, recording, permissions and editing
Authorized final earnings report or underlying rights-sharing terms; never apply a deduction twice
Dated claim decision and channel revenue record; not automatically a cash cost
Dated dispute status and settlement information; do not double-count as final lost income
Invoice and scope of licensed work

historical_events.event: Last documented date for new paid Creator Music licenses; existing applied purchases remain subject to expiry; unused purchases refunded

prohibitions: Do not assume a Creator Music paid-license purchase option still exists in October 2026
Do not treat Creator Music as generally available in every country
Do not apply ordinary watch-page 55% creator-share arithmetic to revenue-sharing music without checking track terms
Do not count held revenue as permanently lost before the dispute is resolved
Do not treat Audio Library licensing as blanket permission to republish its audio outside authorized scope
Do not invent creator cost, rights-loss or hourly income distributions

immediate_effects: Rights holder may monetize, block by territory, or track usage
enforcement_types.limitations: A claim can later lead to a removal request; do not infer guaranteed monetization or view loss.

immediate_effects: If a valid removal request is accepted, content is taken down and a copyright strike applies
Three copyright strikes within a 90-day window can result in channel termination
enforcement_types.limitations: The strike follows an accepted valid removal request, not a routine Content ID match. Actual lost income, restoration, and appeal outcomes are unmeasured.

monetization_interactions.constraint: Creator Music revenue-sharing tracks cannot be used with YouTube Shopping features under the published restrictions
Published restrictions exclude sponsored content whose main purpose is to promote a brand or service; incidental mentions are a different case
